## 素材包商店 · Theme pack store

- 一键更换仪表盘的配色、桌面背景和横幅：仪表盘颜色菜单 →「更多素材包…」，或设置 →「浏览素材包」。
  One-click palettes, desktop backgrounds and banners: dashboard color menu → **More theme packs…**, or Settings → **Browse theme packs**.
- 下载前可预览完整的仪表盘效果图。 Preview a full dashboard mockup before downloading.
- 首批 9 套：3 套免费，6 套精品（11 月 7 日前限时免费，期间下载可永久使用）。
  9 packs: 3 free, 6 premium — free until November 7; packs installed before then stay yours.
- 部分精品包带环境音（雨声、傍晚鸟鸣、城市夜色），播放播客时自动暂停。
  Some premium packs include ambient sound (rain, evening birds, city at night) that pauses while a podcast plays.

## 其他 · Also

- 「透明玻璃」更名为「森林玻璃」；内置主题也会显示在素材包商店中。
  "Transparent glass" is now **Forest glass**; built-in themes appear in the store too.
- 新增英文界面，默认跟随 Obsidian 的语言。 English interface added; follows Obsidian's language by default.

素材从 jsDelivr / GitHub 下载并保存在插件文件夹中，不会写入你的笔记。
Pack files download from jsDelivr / GitHub into the plugin folder, never into your notes.
